insights.one_liner: Under Armour is an American sportswear brand with its European headquarters in Amsterdam, and an IND-recognised sponsor with a few English-language office jobs.

culture.text: The Amsterdam office is the brand's European headquarters; the parent company is based in Baltimore and was founded in 1996.
Its 2 open jobs here are a senior data role and a mid-level finance role, both in Amsterdam.

open.text: Under Armour Europe B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
Both current postings need no Dutch, one mentions visa or relocation, and both show pay.

growth.text: Frasers Group, owned by a British billionaire, has built a significant stake in Under Armour.
The company is trying to reconnect with its football roots and push premium pricing.

worth_knowing.text: A new big investor (Frasers Group) taking a stake could bring changes in strategy or leadership.
Under Armour filed a shelf registration to be able to issue new securities.
